Process.Name: proc_BSCS01_02_03_OnEntered
Process.Description: **Purpose:** Handles truck arrival at battery swap charge station nodes 01-03, assigning truck reference to station and routing to home node. **SetNode HomeNode:** Route truck to its home node (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.HomeNode) **Assign BatteryElectricTruck:** Assign truck object reference to swap station (obj_TransferNode.ParkingStation.Contents.FirstItem.obj_BatterySwapChargeStation.var_BatteryElectricTruckObjectReference ← obj_BatteryElectricTruck) **Fire OnEnteredEvent:** Trigger OnEntered event from tbl_TransferNodes for this node

Step.Name: OnEnteredEvent
Step.Description: **Fire OnEnteredEvent:** Trigger OnEntered event from tbl_TransferNodes for this node

Step.Name: BatteryElectricTruck
Step.Description: **Assign BatteryElectricTruck:** Assign truck object reference to swap station (obj_TransferNode.ParkingStation.Contents.FirstItem.obj_BatterySwapChargeStation.var_BatteryElectricTruckObjectReference ← obj_BatteryElectricTruck)

Step.Name: HomeNode
Step.Description: **SetNode HomeNode:** Route truck to its home node (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.HomeNode)
